CAMS.ind: Depositories Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
CAMS.d: Computer Age Management Services Limited provides mutual fund transfer agency and related services. It is the largest registrar and transfer agent for mutual funds in India.

CANBK.d: Canara Bank is a public sector bank providing retail banking, corporate banking, and international banking services. It serves millions of customers across India through a wide branch network as a state-owned financial institution.

CAPLIPOINT.d: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited manufactures and markets pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients, focusing mainly on Latin America and Africa.

CARTRADE.d: Cartrade Tech Limited operates multi-channel automotive platforms that connect buyers and sellers of vehicles in India. It provides vehicle valuation, listing, and digital marketing services to consumers and dealers.

CASTROLIND.d: Castrol India Limited manufactures and markets automotive and industrial lubricants, greases, and related services. It sells its products to vehicle owners, manufacturers, and industrial clients nationwide.

CCL.d: CCL Products (India) Limited processes and exports instant coffee to global private label brands and retailers. It is one of the largest private label coffee manufacturers in the world.

CDSL.ind: Depositories Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
CDSL.d: Central Depository Services (India) Limited facilitates holding and trading of securities in electronic form. It is one of India's two depositories, serving retail and institutional investors through depository participants.

CEATLTD.d: CEAT manufactures automotive tyres, tubes, and flaps for commercial vehicles, passenger cars, and two-wheelers. Its products are sold to original equipment manufacturers and the replacement market globally.

CENTRALBK.d: Central Bank of India is a state-owned public sector bank providing retail banking, corporate banking, and rural financial services across India.

CENTURYPLY.d: Century Plyboards manufactures plywood, laminates, medium-density fiberboards, and particle boards for residential and commercial interiors. It is one of the largest manufacturers of wood panel products in India.

CESC.d: CESC Limited generates and distributes electricity to consumers in Kolkata and parts of West Bengal. The integrated power utility serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers.

CGCL.d: Capri Global Capital provides retail lending, microfinance, and wholesale loan products targeting underserved segments and MSMEs. The non-banking financial company operates across multiple states in India.

CGPOWER.d: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited manufactures heavy electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, and industrial motors. Its main customers are power utilities, railways, and industrial enterprises.

CHALET.d: Chalet Hotels Limited owns, develops, and manages upscale hotels and commercial properties in India. It partners with global hospitality brands to operate its properties.

CHAMBLFERT.d: Chambal Fertilizers and Chemicals manufactures and markets urea and other crop nutrients for the agricultural sector. It is a major private sector fertilizer producer in India.

CHOICEIN.d: Choice International offers financial services including broking, advisory, and lending through its subsidiaries. It serves retail, institutional, and corporate clients across India.

CHOLAFIN.d: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company provides vehicle finance, home loans, and SME loans across India. It is a non-banking financial company promoted by the Murugappa Group.

CHOLAHLDNG.d: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited operates as a core investment company holding investments in financial services businesses. Through its subsidiaries, it provides vehicle finance, home loans, and general insurance products.

CIEINDIA.d: CIE Automotive India manufactures automotive components including forgings, castings, gears, and composites. It supplies directly to major vehicle manufacturers worldwide.

CIPLA.d: Cipla develops and manufactures generic and proprietary pharmaceutical formulations and respiratory products. Its customers include healthcare providers, hospitals, and patients globally.

COALINDIA.d: Coal India Limited produces and supplies coal primarily for the power and steel sectors in India. It is a state-owned enterprise and the single largest coal-producing company globally.

COCHINSHIP.d: Cochin Shipyard Limited builds and repairs commercial and defense vessels. It is a state-owned enterprise serving domestic and international marine transport and defense clients.

COFORGE.d: Coforge Limited provides computer programming, consultancy, and IT services. It serves global clients in insurance, banking, financial services, and travel industries.

COLPAL.d: Colgate-Palmolive India manufactures and sells personal care products, focusing primarily on oral care items like toothpastes and toothbrushes. It serves retail consumers nationwide and is a subsidiary of Colgate-Palmolive Company.

CONCOR.d: Container Corporation of India Limited operates a network of container depots and terminals for cargo transport and logistics. It provides rail and road-based logistics solutions to industrial customers and is a state-owned enterprise.

COROMANDEL.d: Coromandel International manufactures and markets fertilizers, crop protection products, and specialty nutrients for farmers across India. The Murugappa Group company is one of India's largest private phosphatic fertilizer manufacturers.

CRAFTSMAN.d: Craftsman Automation manufactures precision components for the automotive and industrial sectors, including engine parts, gear box housings, and industrial machinery components.

CREDITACC.d: CreditAccess Grameen Limited provides microfinance services to women in rural and semi-urban areas of India. It operates through a joint liability group lending model.

CRISIL.d: Crisil Limited provides ratings, research, and risk and policy advisory services. Its main customers are financial institutions, corporates, and government entities globally.

CUB.d: City Union Bank operates as a private sector bank, offering retail and corporate banking services primarily in South India. It focuses on small and medium enterprises and agricultural lending.

CUMMINSIND.d: Cummins India Limited manufactures and distributes diesel and natural gas engines, generators, and related components. It serves industrial, automotive, and power generation markets across India and international regions.

CUPID.d: Cupid Limited manufactures male and female condoms, water-based lubricants, and in-vitro diagnostic kits. It supplies products to institutional clients, governments, and retail markets worldwide.

CYIENT.d: Cyient Limited provides engineering, manufacturing, and digital technology solutions. Its main customers are aerospace, defense, healthcare, and communication enterprises worldwide.
